name: foundry-iq
description: Foundry IQ knowledge base starter with Azure AI Search MCP retrieval and per-request source authorization forwarding.

envVars.name: AZURE_AI_SEARCH_ENDPOINT
envVars.description: Azure AI Search endpoint that hosts the Foundry IQ knowledge base, for example https://<service>.search.windows.net.

envVars.name: FOUNDRY_IQ_KNOWLEDGE_BASE
envVars.description: Foundry IQ knowledge base name used in the MCP endpoint path.

envVars.name: FOUNDRY_IQ_QUERY_SOURCE_AUTHORIZATION
envVars.description: Optional local-dev fallback for the x-ms-query-source-authorization header. Prefer per-request user auth in production.
